# notes.md — sphinx-8551-panel (issue: :type:/:rtype: false ambiguous lookup)

## Task
TASK.md: fix Sphinx bug "":type: and :rtype: gives false ambiguous class lookup warnings".
Minimal fix in sphinx/ source only. No test edits, no commit.

## Environment (verified)
- Repo: C:/Users/agent/work/work/sphinx-8551-panel
  (Sphinx 3.4.0 checkout, git 57ed10c68 "Merge PR #8548 ... 741_inherited_ivar").
  NOTE: run_command cwd is NOT the file-tool root; always cd explicitly.
- Working test interpreter: C:/Windows/Temp/sph9658_venv/bin/python (sphinx imports from this
  checkout, docutils 0.23). `python3 -m pytest tests/test_domain_py.py -q` → 32 passed.
- campaign/.venv: docutils 0.20 but sphinxcontrib-* 2.0 require Sphinx 5 →
  VersionRequirementError; unusable. live-test/.venv: no sphinx deps.
- Repro project C:/Windows/Temp/repro8551 (TASK.md rst verbatim) reproduces: 4 warnings
  "more than one target found for cross-reference 'A': mod.A, mod.submod.A"
  and `A` links to #mod.A instead of #mod.submod.A.

## Code map (all in sphinx/domains/python.py unless noted)
- type_to_xref() L81: builds pending_xref for type strings; sets py:module/py:class
  from env.ref_context, but does NOT set refspecific.
- PyXrefMixin.make_xref L268: sets result['refspecific'] = True (used by PyField/
  PyTypedField/PyGroupedField for :param:/:rtype: etc.).
- PyField L309, PyTypedField L324 (None→obj special case).
- sphinx/util/docfields.py Field.make_xref L68: creates pending_xref, calls
  env.get_domain(domain).process_field_xref(refnode) (domains/__init__.py L312;
  py domain does NOT override it — c/cpp do: attributes.update(env.ref_context)).
- sphinx/roles.py XRefRole.create_xref_node L142: explicit roles set refdoc +
  refexplicit; PyXRefRole.process_link (python.py L1033) sets refnode['py:module'].
- PythonDomain.find_obj L1236: searchmode=1 (refspecific) → exact modname match,
  else bare name, else FUZZY search over ALL objects (this is the ambiguous path);
  searchmode=0 → exact only.
- resolve_xref L1292: searchmode = 1 if node.hasattr('refspecific') else 0.

## Root cause hypothesis (to verify)
:type:/:rtype: xrefs get refspecific=True (PyXrefMixin) but NO py:module context
(type_to_xref passes py:module only when env passed; :rtype: path may lack it, or
find_obj's searchmode=1 fuzzy branch fires before trying parent-module walk).
Explicit :py:class:`A` resolves via searchmode=0 exact chain (modname+name first).
Next: dump pending_xref attrs for :rtype: vs explicit role in repro to compare.
